description: This file implements a logging utility for the Miracast project, providing functions to initialize, manage, and perform logging with timestamp and thread ID annotations, supporting both file and stderr outputs.

methods.name: sync_stdout
methods.description: Configures stdout buffering based on environment variable 'SYNC_STDOUT'.

methods.name: methodName
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a pretty function string.

methods.name: logger_init
methods.description: Initializes the logger, setting log level, creating log files if configured, and setting the service name.

methods.name: logger_deinit
methods.description: De-initializes the logger, closing log files and destroying synchronization primitives.

methods.name: enable_separate_logger
methods.description: Switches logging to a separate log file specified by filename.

methods.name: disable_separate_logger
methods.description: Reverts logging to default (stdout or stderr).

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp, thread ID, function, file, line, and message formatting, supporting different log levels.
